ContactFormSubmission.title: Contact Form Submission
ContactFormSubmission.description: A submission from the website contact form.

fullName.description: The full name of the person.

email.description: The email address of the person.

contactNumber.description: The contact number of the person.

submissionDate.description: The date and time of the submission.

AdminUser.title: Admin User
AdminUser.description: An administrator user for the website.

uid.description: The user's unique ID from Firebase Auth.

role.description: The role of the user, e.g., 'admin'.

createdAt.description: The date and time the user was created.

WebBanner.title: Web Banner
WebBanner.description: A desktop banner for the website hero section.

imageUrl.description: The URL of the banner image in Firebase Storage.

status.description: Indicates if the banner is active or inactive.

position.description: The display order of the banner.

createdAt.description: The date and time the banner was created.

MobileBanner.title: Mobile Banner
MobileBanner.description: A mobile banner for the website hero section.

imageUrl.description: The URL of the banner image in Firebase Storage.

status.description: Indicates if the banner is active or inactive.

position.description: The display order of the banner.

createdAt.description: The date and time the banner was created.

GalleryItem.title: Gallery Item
GalleryItem.description: An item for the website gallery, can be an image or a video.

type.description: The type of the gallery item.

title.description: The title or description of the gallery item.

imageUrl.description: The URL of the image in Firebase Storage (for image type).

videoUrl.description: The URL of the external video (for video type).

status.description: Indicates if the item is active or inactive.

createdAt.description: The date and time the item was created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time the item was last updated.

/contactFormSubmissions/{submissionId}.description: Stores all submissions from the contact form.

/webBanners/{bannerId}.description: Stores desktop banners for the homepage.

/mobileBanners/{bannerId}.description: Stores mobile banners for the homepage.
